description: This file defines a Perl package 'metadata' that exports data structures and functions related to parsing and managing package metadata, target configurations, and associated metadata in a software build or packaging system.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiline string data from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, concatenating lines with optional prefix.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Sanitizes a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specifications from metadata, validating IDs and names, and updating corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads target configuration metadata from a file and constructs structured representations of build targets, profiles, and dependencies.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets all package-related global hashes to empty states.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses detailed package metadata from a file, populating data structures for packages, sources, and overrides.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest information, similar to a repository metadata file, and stores package details.
